purpose: Historical checkpoint evidence; not full qualification. Raw captures and recordings remain local and are not included in Git. Source-machine paths inside records are historical.

rain-later-full-state/native-episode-sum.scope: native first full run diagnostic; launcher exit1 retained; not repeat qualification or physical acceptance
rain-later-full-state/native-episode-sum.identity_validation: all42cell bodies each selected frame slot/generation matched and q/v/w float32 bits exact

twist.limitation: cached final impulse/h and reconstructed stiffness, not complete per-substep torque balance

state-identity-membership-audit.json.status: two persistent fields classified; broader audit remains open

step_force_slots.consumer: set_step_forces clears every previous member to zero before writing new loads; has_step_forces observes only emptiness
step_force_slots.excluded: vector order and duplicate zero writes; no ordering-dependent new load writes
step_force_slots.guard: state_trace rejects members that do not reference a captured live body

shape_identities.representation: shape_storage_order from actual sim.shape_identities; references checked against live world shape generation
shape_identities.consumer: shape remapping and old/new storage correspondence
shape_identities.identity_contract: public shape slots append-only; add_shape pushes a new slot and generations are checked before rendering semantic references
shape_identities.negative_control: mutate only sim shape generation: capture rejects stale shape identity without appending a frame; restore then force-membership corruption also rejects

timing-window-state-audit.json.status: timing-window scheduling coverage corrected; broader persistent-state audit open
timing-window-state-audit.json.finding: metrics.submitted < metrics.steps suppresses native full-step replay; durations are not the scheduling state
timing-window-state-audit.json.capture: gpu_policy.timing_window contains steps/submitted when Some; absent is canonical no-window
timing-window-state-audit.json.compatibility: prior v19 captures only qualified for this field when timing window independently proved absent; no blanket retrospective active-window coverage
timing-window-state-audit.json.rain_applicability: begin_timing_window reachable through Rust b3_world_begin_timing and direct diagnostic tests; no C ABI/native-samples call or bridge found; existing Rain frozen binaries do not open windows
